tasks.subject: Task 1: Purchasing page redesign
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Convert both create forms to dialog modals, fix CSS token violations, remove embedded forms from page body.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/app/app/purchasing/po-create-form.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/purchasing/po-line-form.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/purchasing/page.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/purchasing/purchasing.module.css`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Both create forms render as modal dialogs
- [ ] Trigger buttons in PageHeader actions
- [ ] No embedded forms in page body
- [ ] Input borders use --stroke-strong
- [ ] npx tsc --noEmit passes

**Verify:** `npx tsc --noEmit`

tasks.subject: Task 2: Inventory page redesign
tasks.description:

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/app/app/inventory/movement-form.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/inventory/page.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/inventory/inventory.module.css`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] No two-column layout
- [ ] MovementForm is dialog modal in PageHeader actions
- [ ] Balance view is tableCard/table
- [ ] Recent movements is ListPanel
- [ ] Summary panel removed
- [ ] tsc passes

**Verify:** `npx tsc --noEmit`
